npc-cycles: Transparent sprite sheet, 1536x1024, FOUR rows and FOUR columns,16 equal cells. Authorial industrial steampunk pixel art, same warm restrained leather/bronze/charcoal palette as Black Bird: Revolução. Each ROW is one DIFFERENT civilian and all FOUR cells show FOUR consecutive articulated WALK CYCLE poses facing right: contact left, passing right, contact right, passing left. Adult height200px per256px-high cell, feet baseline y240, ample margins, hips centered x192. Row1 older woman merchant in layered work dress, shawl and sensible boots. Row2 adult factory worker in cap, worn jacket and boots, no weapon. Row3 adult female street mechanic in practical overalls, apron/tool belt and leather gloves, no prosthesis. Row4 city guard in tailored industrial uniform, long coat and peaked cap, unarmed for this opening. Every character consistent across its row, legs alternate support and arms counterbalance; no single-pose translations, no floating, no changes of clothing/anatomy. Subtle individual silhouettes and ages, not recolors. No text/grid/labels/checkerboard/background/shadow/smoke/extra objects, TRUE alpha. Clear readable full-body side view, detailed but controlled pixel clusters, no photorealistic blur. This is a real sprite resource in review, not a concept poster.
